driver: A non-negativity floor does not commute with an entitlement split across a partition, so the split has to be applied first and the floor at the sub-unit grain, and the natural pipeline that nets and floors once at the keyed parent grain understates the total while every control total still ties.
driver_concrete: Proceeds are divided among the parties on the division of proceeds before setoff, which reaches only the Debtor's share (security agreement 3.1), and each payee line is floored at nil (terms 3.3), so landlords on 54 underwater accounts are paid and the run is $9,450,518.62, not $7,515,618.34.
stump: A competent solver collapses the transfer tickets, scopes to Price Later contracts, then settles one grain account at a time (setoff and nil floor per account, the grain every source system is keyed to) and files $7,515,618.34, 20.47 per cent low, because every control total ties under that order.
